verdict.rationale: Firstbase publishes recurring registered-agent pricing of "$299 per state/year" billed annually, which documents the renewal charge. The evidence contains nothing on cancellation terms or transferring the registered agent away from Firstbase. Its agent-change language covers only switching in to Firstbase, so the 'not stranded on exit' half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented cancellation policy, transfer-out/registered-agent change-away process, refund or auto-renewal terms, independent corroboration of exit experience
